title: PDE-Residual-Informed Kriging
abstract: arXiv:2610.41590v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Physics-informed Gaussian process (GP) methods provide a probabilistic framework for PDE solving. Existing approaches incorporate PDE information in different ways: pointwise conditioning uses the governing equation only at finitely many selected locations, globally constrained GPs restrict the admissible functions to satisfy the PDE exactly, and residual-penalized methods control the PDE mismatch over the whole domain through an additional penalty weight. What is still missing is a GP formulation that directly incorporates global PDE-residual information of the entire domain into its covariance structure, while retaining model flexibility and standard GP conditioning without a separate residual-weight parameter. To solve this issue, this study proposes PDE-residual-informed Kriging (PRIK) based on a PDE-residual kernel. tldr: 本文提出基于PDE残差核的PDE残差信息克里金法（PRIK），将整个定义域上的全局PDE残差信息直接融入高斯过程的协方差结构，在保持模型灵活性与标准GP条件化的同时，无需额外的残差权重参数。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes PDE-residual-informed Kriging (PRIK), which directly incorporates global PDE-residual information over the entire domain into the GP covariance structure through a novel PDE-residual kernel, achieving flexible PDE solving with standard GP conditioning and without a separate residual-weight parameter.
